reviews.t: Hair wrap is a pandemic necessity Part 2
reviews.x: Because of Covid-19 I haven’t been able to get my hair cut. Head wraps are a perfect solution. I love the stretch in the material and the solid colors easily match outfits. Plus learning to tie the scarfs  is so much fun.

This product was EXACTLY what I had been searching for! It is very soft to the touch and versatile. It is great if you're looking for something that can be used for many styles such as a head wrap, turban, hijab, scarf, etc. I will definitely purchase more in different colors.

Soft and i am staying cool..my head doesn't feel suffocated..and the stretch ability is just right so my head doesn't feel squeezed, wanting to give me a headache...colors are vibrantly pretty, though the fabric is see through-able..I like them a lot. I expected worse for real lol

Yes, I loved everything about these headwraps. It took a little practice before I achieved this look.  The red was my favorite color of the 4 colors you get. The material is soft to the touch having a stretchy jersey cotton feel, but substantially strong, not flimsy or see through. It's fair to say that I'm a satisfied customer. If you're on the fence about buying these, I highly recommend them. They are worth it for the reasonable price. I hope to buy more colors.
I lost all of my hair due to chemo. I do have hats and scarfs but these head wraps are the best. One scarf so many styles you can do!
I am new to head wraps so don’t judge but I feel like I did ok for a newbie. I like these and wish they came in prints.

Winter is coming… Perfect wrap, colors were a little off…the wine is very much Red…but then again Whens the last time you’ve checked how many different colors variations there are??? Overall satisfied customer, already have another order on the way.

So if I could do 4.5 stars, I would. I only took 0.5 stars off because there’s a small caveat: the fabric is soft and comfortable- but because of this, it tends to slide off a little and may need to be readjusted. Otherwise….  I ❤️ this product. I bought it because my hair tends to be “crazy” and is fluffy and goes everywhere. Sometimes it is beautiful- other times I need to wrap it- especially when working (I am in Healthcare). Funny thing, is one day I was lazy & in a hurry- so I decided to we
Described accurately. Only downfall, I wish it was a little longer as I have really long dreadlocks. Perfect stretch material feels comfortable and breathable.
The head wraps are beautiful! Great quality and very durable. You won’t be disappointed.
I love these scarfs. They are the perfect size and cover everything. You can dress up your edges leave some hair out whatever! Best purchase for convenience and a different look.

reviews.t: I. Want. One. In. Every. Color
reviews.x: There’s nothing about these scarves that I don’t like. Very versatile and comfortable, like the title said - I’ll be getting one in every color ✊🏽
I love the softness of the material . The ease I can do my head wraps and the price!

reviews.t: Comfy, versatile, give yourself extra time to get the styles you want until you are more adept.
reviews.x: Can be used several different ways. Depending on which design you are trying to recreate you need to be patient and give yourself plenty of EXTRA time putting on, unless you are already skilled at it.
4 super long head scarfs/wraps.. perfect for making turbans n such. Very lightweight material.. doesn’t make my head hot
Beautiful, long, thick, durable material!! All four colors are vibrant and easy to wrap!! Definitely worth the money!!
I wanted to wear this with a bun on top but maybe my head is too big. I couldn’t get it to twist and actually stay. Like it needed another 3 to 4 inches of length.
[[VIDEOID:ba9a74182533438c6ba023bf3603a04]] Simply awesome... just as advertised

I had been trying to find wraps that had just the right amount of softness and stretch. These fit the bill nicely.  They aren't too thick or thin, and can be worn year round. They are a good length as well. I will be buying more colors and would recommend their purchase!

Not only are these wraps beautiful but I was surprised when they did not slip off my head. Thats my biggest pet peeve with head wraps. I like to leave a little of my edges out. This works perfectly for me. Love these wraps!
These head wraps are EVERYTHING!! They are versatile and stylish. Buying in different color options.
Great material, perfect for chemo headscarves!

I really don't have nothing negative to say, they are really nice turbans I do wish they were just a little longer other than that they are made well they wash well and the colors are lovely. Don't get me wrong you can do a lot with them however with just a bit more length the wrapping would be a little more relaxed if you will other than that great find I would recommend.

Just what I was looking for I made this purchase for those day when you just don't feel like STYLING your hair ladies you know what I'm talking  about however I still will like to look Chic & Classy these  head wrap are comfortable & stretchy  I love them I will purchase more I HIGHLY RECOMMENDS THEM

This scarf/headwrap is AWESOME! Super soft and stretchy with finished edges and great weight to it. I WISH it came in more colors. The tie dye coloring is extremely beautiful. GREAT VALUE!!! Buy these now!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the soft, comfortable material and its breathable, non-suffocating feel.
Many customers highlight the versatility of the wraps, noting they can be styled many different ways.
Several reviewers mention the stretchy material and good fit, though a few note it can slide off or wish it were longer.
Some customers note that tying the styles takes practice and extra time for beginners.
A few reviewers mention color discrepancies or see-through fabric, while others find the material durable and not flimsy.

qa.q: Will this head wrap fit my head comfortably?
qa.answer: Reviews describe the wraps as soft and stretchy with a good length [1], but one reviewer found it not quite long enough and couldn't get it to twist and stay, suggesting it needed another 3 to 4 inches [6].

claims.text: The wraps are soft and stretchy with a good length.
One reviewer found it not quite long enough and couldn't get it to twist and stay, needing another 3 to 4 inches.

qa.q: Is the fabric breathable and soft for all-day wear?
qa.answer: Yes, reviews describe the fabric as soft and breathable: one notes it "feels comfortable and breathable" [6], and others praise its softness [1][2][5]. One reviewer says it stays cool and doesn't feel suffocating [1], though another notes the soft fabric tends to slide off and need readjusting [3].

qa.q: Does it stay in place without slipping?
qa.answer: Yes, one reviewer specifically noted the wraps did not slip off their head [1]. No reviews reported slipping.

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it worth the price for four pieces?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate the four wraps are worth it: one reviewer says they are "worth it" and highly recommends them [2], and others praise the quality and durability [6]. However, one reviewer wished they were a little longer [3].
